basic_profile.bio: I'm a budding home chef based in Mississauga, Ontario, who recently moved to the area and loves experimenting with different cuisines. I enjoy skateboarding during my free time and am currently exploring the world of video games, especially Nintendo classics. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight. By day, I work as a junior graphic designer at a local firm. I'm single and enjoy spending weekends exploring new culinary ingredients and techniques.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a self-taught background in cooking, starting with simple recipes and gradually moving to more complex dishes by watching online tutorials and following cooking blogs. My interest in spices and herbs grew from a desire to replicate restaurant-quality dishes at home. Additionally, I have a keen interest in video games and skateboarding, which I've learned through online communities and practice.
